planets.name: TIC 38825265 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TIC 38825265 with a 3.31-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TIC 38825265 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TIC 38825265. Its orbit and size follow Lafarga et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
